name: Teleport

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

targets.description: you and up to eight willing creatures you can see, or one object that fits in a 10-foot Cube

summary: You and up to eight willing creatures (or one object) teleport anywhere on this plane; how well you know the place decides where you land.
text: Roll 1d100: a permanent circle or a linked object is always on target; very familiar is mishap 01-05, similar area 06-13, off target 14-24; seen casually 01-33, 34-43, 44-53; viewed once or described 01-43, 44-53, 54-73; a false destination is mishap 01-50, else similar area. Off target lands 1d10 x 1d10 percent of the distance away in a random direction, and a mishap deals 3d10 Force to each traveller before you roll again.
